candidates.change_summary: Change logical OR to AND so supportsInterface returns true only if both interfaceIds match (narrower condition).
Invert the comparison so supportsInterface reports true when interfaceId does NOT equal IAccessControl (broader/altered condition).
Always return false, making supportsInterface never report support for any interface.
Always return true, making supportsInterface claim support for all interfaces (broader behavior).
Only defer to parent implementation, removing the explicit check for IAccessControl (may change reported support for that interface).
Replace return expression to negate stored membership, so hasRole returns !members[account] instead of members[account].
Replace return expression to always return true, so hasRole always reports the account has the role.
Replace return expression to always return false, so hasRole always reports the account does not have the role.
Change return to check membership of msg.sender instead of the supplied account, so hasRole(role, account) reports whether msg.sender has the role.
Insert a special-case that grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to everyone, so hasRole returns true if role is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, otherwise original check.
